name: gemma4-dev
description: Claude Code plugins for Google Cloud TPU DevOps: one management skill and one MCP server per Gemma 4 serving rig (JAX, PyTorch/torch_xla). Both are named after the rig directory — skill <rig>-management, tools prefixed mcp__<rig>__.

plugins.name: gce-jaxrust-v6e1-2b
plugins.description: Manage Google Cloud TPU capacity and Gemma 4 serving from Rust on Compute Engine TPU VMs: flex-start provisioning, capacity probing, quotas, cost estimates, and SRE diagnostics via the gce-jaxrust-v6e1-2b MCP server. The engine is Rust — rlx's JAX-shaped IR lowered to HLO and executed through libtpu's PJRT plugin, no Python in the serving path. Forked from tpu-jax-v6e1-2b 2026-08-28; nothing provisioned or measured on this path yet.

plugins.name: gpu-jax-g5g-2b
plugins.description: EC2 G5g DevOps for the pure-JAX Gemma 4 E2B rig: instance lifecycle, G-family quotas, arm64 GPU DLAMI resolution, JAX-on-Turing verification, and SRE diagnostics via the gpu-jax-g5g-2b MCP server. Serves google/gemma-4-E2B-it on an NVIDIA T4G (Turing, SM 7.5) behind an AWS Graviton2 host — no build, no CUDA toolkit, no Triton patch, because jax[cuda12] publishes aarch64 wheels that already carry sm_75.

plugins.name: gpu-jaxrust-g5g-2b
plugins.description: EC2 G5g DevOps for the Rust-driven-XLA Gemma 4 E2B rig: instance lifecycle, G-family quotas, arm64 GPU DLAMI resolution, Turing verification, and SRE diagnostics via the gpu-jaxrust-g5g-2b MCP server. Forked from gpu-jax-g5g-2b 2026-08-28 to move the engine off CPython onto Rust. The control plane is complete and measured nothing yet — the Rust engine is not written, and the rig currently runs the inherited Python JAX engine as its fallback and parity oracle.

plugins.name: gpu-vllm-g5g-2b
plugins.description: EC2 G5g DevOps for the vLLM Gemma 4 E2B rig: instance lifecycle, G-family quotas, arm64 AMI resolution, SM 7.5 build orchestration, and SRE diagnostics via the gpu-vllm-g5g-2b MCP server. Serves google/gemma-4-E2B-it on an NVIDIA T4G (Turing) behind an AWS Graviton2 host — the one rig here whose GPU has no prebuilt aarch64 CUDA kernels.

plugins.name: tpu-jax-v5e1-2b
plugins.description: TPU DevOps for the pure-JAX Gemma 4 rig: provisioning, queued resources, quotas, cost estimates, benchmarking, and SRE diagnostics via the tpu-jax-v5e1-2b MCP server. Serves google/gemma-4-E2B-it-qat-w4a16-ct on v5e-1 with no Docker and no HF token.

plugins.name: tpu-jax-v6e1-2b
plugins.description: Manage Google Cloud TPU capacity and Gemma 4 JAX serving on Compute Engine TPU VMs: flex-start provisioning, capacity probing, quotas, cost estimates, benchmarking, and SRE diagnostics via the tpu-jax-v6e1-2b MCP server.

plugins.name: tpu-pytorch-v5e1-12b
plugins.description: TPU DevOps for the PyTorch/torch_xla Gemma 4 12B rig: provisioning, queued resources, quotas, cost estimates, benchmarking, and SRE diagnostics via the tpu-pytorch-v5e1-12b MCP server. Static-shape decode server on v5e-1.

plugins.name: tpu-pytorch-v5e1-2b
plugins.description: TPU DevOps for the PyTorch/torch_xla Gemma 4 2B rig: provisioning, queued resources, quotas, cost estimates, benchmarking, and SRE diagnostics via the tpu-pytorch-v5e1-2b MCP server. Static-shape decode server on v5e-1.
